search_window.basis: Bounded supplementary recall since previous hourly check. Older publication dates considered only when a material previously unrecorded report is recovered; source publication time distinguished from the watch discovery time.

findings.title: Trump's Board of Peace faults Israel and Hamas for failure to end Gaza war
findings.location: Gaza Strip / United Nations Security Council reporting process, New York
findings.affected_population_or_system: Gaza ceasefire implementation, civilian security, humanitarian access, reconstruction and preparations for winter flooding; affected population includes displaced Gazans dependent on shelter and supplies.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: a ceasefire that delivers nothing visible cannot be sustained indefinitely.
findings.source_type: Established first-hand document-based reporting; Reuters says it reviewed the Board of Peace's 12-page second report to the UN Security Council; original document not independently retrieved

bounded_discovery_context.discovery_method: Found during a capped set of 12 targeted news/humanitarian searches; followed a direct Reuters article link and checked the publisher's full report. Cross-checked against authenticated previous watch heartbeat and official-first OCHA OPT/WHO checks.
bounded_discovery_context.publication_vs_window: Published November 18 at 11:19 UTC (03:19 PST), before the 13:47:59 PST previous watch ended; newly recovered report, not a claim that the underlying ceasefire violation began this hour.
bounded_discovery_context.distinct_increment: Reuters obtained a 12-page Board of Peace report, its second to the Security Council, warning that both parties' noncompliance threatens the process; document faults Israeli restrictions on flood-preparation supplies and uncertainty over Palestinian civilian policing, and alleges Hamas taxes on goods impair commodity access. Expected presentation to UNSC at end of November, not yet confirmed delivered.
bounded_discovery_context.unverified: Report issuance date and full text not independently available; the article describes an expected future UNSC presentation. Claims attributed to report rather than independently verified operational measurements.
bounded_discovery_context.duplicate_controls: Previously captured central Gaza ground advance and displacement, individual deaths, court detention extension, Erez inspections and OCHA exposure figures were not re-counted.
